tools.name: search_medicines
tools.description: Search DoseFacts for medicines (brand names, generic/salt names) and taxonomy hubs (active ingredients, conditions, drug classes).

tools.name: get_medicine
tools.description: Get the structured medicine fact sheet for a brand slug (uses, how it works, general usage notes, side effects, warnings, interactions, overdose, regulatory status, sources, and review status).

tools.name: get_taxonomy_hub
tools.description: Get a DoseFacts taxonomy hub page for an active ingredient (salt), medical condition, or drug class, including its summary, clinical facts, linked medicines, sources, and review status.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List all languages supported by DoseFacts with their codes, English names, native names, and scope.
